name: Takasugi Chisato
source:
A passionate housewife. She has too much free time because she has a housekeeper who does all the housekeeping work for her. 
She had a fling with Issei on the island of Bali. 
She is a bit of a exhibitionist.

[from [url=http://www.timsvault.com/pcgames_h/hitozuma.txt]a walkthrough by Eko Raharjo[/url]]
